parameter.name: shadow
parameter.label: Shadow Mode
parameter.description: Only log what would have been done, never act on it. On for a fresh installation, so the decisions can be compared against the automation already in place before anything is handed over.

parameter.name: stopped
parameter.label: Master Stop
parameter.description: Halt everything: while it is engaged the engine takes no snapshot, invokes no algorithm, and enforces no device protection. Releasing it resumes normal operation.

parameter.name: cycleInterval
parameter.label: Evaluation Interval
parameter.description: How often the engine evaluates the site.

parameter.name: eventResponsive
parameter.label: Event Responsive
parameter.description: Also evaluate between ticks, as soon as something relevant changes, instead of only on the fixed interval.

parameter.name: triggerDebounce
parameter.label: Trigger Debounce
parameter.description: Shortest time between two evaluations triggered between ticks. Zero runs every trigger.

parameter.name: ackHandling
parameter.label: Acknowledgement Handling
parameter.description: Who keeps track of commands a device has not confirmed yet: the engine, or the adapter that writes to the device.

parameter.name: ackWindow
parameter.label: Acknowledgement Window
parameter.description: How long to wait for a device to report the value it was commanded before giving up on that command and deciding afresh.

parameter.name: ackSuppressChangedCommands
parameter.label: Suppress Changed Commands
parameter.description: Also hold back a command that differs from the one still outstanding.

parameter.name: actuationSink
parameter.label: Actuation Sink
parameter.description: Id of the actuation sink to dispatch to. Empty means the engine only logs; a writing sink is used only when it is named here.

parameter.name: shadowedAlgorithms
parameter.label: Shadowed Algorithms
parameter.description: Algorithms kept in shadow mode while shadow mode is off for everything else.

parameter.name: shadowedParticipants
parameter.label: Shadowed Participants
parameter.description: Devices kept in shadow mode while shadow mode is off for everything else.

parameter.name: budget
parameter.label: Site Power Budget
parameter.description: Total power the site may draw. Left empty the engine enforces no total budget.

parameter.name: phaseBudgets
parameter.label: Per Phase Budgets
parameter.description: Power each phase may draw, written as phase:watts and separated by commas, for example 1:5750,2:5750,3:5750.

parameter.name: nominalVoltage
parameter.label: Nominal Phase Voltage
parameter.description: The voltage used to convert a current limit into a power, so that devices declared in amperes can be weighed against a budget in watts.

parameter.name: staleAfter
parameter.label: Measurement Staleness Age
parameter.description: Age at which a measurement counts as stale. Zero disables the age check, so only a measurement that cannot be read at all trips the safe state.

parameter.name: derivation
parameter.label: Level Derivation
parameter.description: How the four price bands are cut out of a day of prices: by a fixed number of slots per band, or by a share of the day. The two differ only when several slots carry the same price.

options.option: Fixed number of slots per band
Fraction of the series per band

parameter.name: overcapacitySlots
parameter.label: Overcapacity Slots
parameter.description: Number of cheapest slots classified as overcapacity.

parameter.name: encouragedSlots
parameter.label: Encouraged Slots
parameter.description: Number of next cheapest slots classified as encouraged.

parameter.name: blockedSlots
parameter.label: Blocked Slots
parameter.description: Number of dearest slots classified as blocked.

parameter.name: overcapacityFraction
parameter.label: Overcapacity Fraction
parameter.description: Share of the day classified as overcapacity, used by the percentile derivation. The default of one sixth is four slots of a twenty-four hour day.

parameter.name: encouragedFraction
parameter.label: Encouraged Fraction
parameter.description: Share of the day classified as encouraged, used by the percentile derivation. The default of one sixth is four slots of a twenty-four hour day.

parameter.name: blockedFraction
parameter.label: Blocked Fraction
parameter.description: Share of the day classified as blocked, used by the percentile derivation. The default of one sixth is four slots of a twenty-four hour day.

parameter.name: encouragedFrom
parameter.label: Encouraged From
parameter.description: Surplus from which the current level is raised to encouraged. There is no default: until this is set, a photovoltaic surplus never raises the level and the site is reported as having no escalation threshold.

parameter.name: overcapacityFrom
parameter.label: Overcapacity From
parameter.description: Surplus from which the current level is raised to overcapacity. Twice Encouraged From when left empty.

parameter.name: objective
parameter.label: Optimization Objective
parameter.description: What the planner optimizes for. Leaving it unset optimizes for cost, which is what the framework did before the objective became selectable. A contributed objective is selected by its own id, which is not in this list.

parameter.name: absentDataPlane
parameter.label: Objective Without Data
parameter.description: What happens when the selected objective has no series to rank on, for example the carbon objective on a site with no carbon source installed. The specification leaves this open; owner decision D33 settled it for this implementation. An objective that cannot be served is not offered at all, rather than silently answered with a different one.

options.option: Optimize for cost instead, and report it
Do not offer an objective whose data is missing
Plan nothing rather than optimize for something else

parameter.name: exportCarbonCredit
parameter.label: Export Carbon Credit
parameter.description: What an exported kilowatt-hour is worth to the carbon objective. The shipped rule withdraws the credit while the feed-in price is negative, on the reasoning that a negative price is the market refusing the power so the generation it would displace is never displaced. That rule rests on reasoning alone, with no source behind it, and this parameter is how it is overturned.

options.option: No credit while the feed-in price is negative
Credit every export, whatever the price

parameter.name: levelInput
parameter.label: Level Input
parameter.description: Which series the four energy levels are cut out of: the effective consumption price, or the active objective's own ranking. Whether levels should follow the objective is open in the specification; every system behind it has only ever run price-based levels, which is what the default keeps.

parameter.name: carbonSource
parameter.label: Carbon Source
parameter.description: Id of the carbon source to read, when more than one is installed. Empty reads the highest ranked one.

parameter.name: sources
parameter.label: Declaration Sources
parameter.description: Which mechanisms may declare devices to the engine. Empty uses all of them; naming one runs the site on that mechanism alone. Which mechanism wins when two of them describe the same device is fixed, not configured: your own metadata beats a contributed declaration, which beats a discovered proposal.
